    circle: int,
    square: int,

        case Shape.square(w):
            return w * w

def main() -> int:
    return area(Shape.circle(2))

files.shared/geometry.my:
module shared.geometry
export area

def area(w: int, h: int) -> int:
    return w * h

def hidden() -> int:
    return 2

export test_area
def test_area() -> bool:
    return area(2, 3) == 6

export Rect
record Rect:
    w: int
    h: int
    tags: list[str]

export tag
def tag(r: Rect, name: str) -> None:
    r.tags.append(name)

export bump_all
def bump_all(xs: list[int]) -> None:
    xs.append(1)
